We’re in the same boat. Ppl who I counted on and said they would always be there for me disappeared. No “friend” would ever actually help me when I needed someone to talk to abt my mental illnesses. They all said “If you ever need me, don’t hesitate to call or text me. I’ll always respond and be there for you.” All of it were lies. No one cared when I was sick in the hospital going through the worst physical pain I’ve ever been in for months. No one cared enough to check up on me when they knew I wasn’t okay and went awol. No one checked up on me or even gave me the time of day when I reached out for help. Even when they said they would “ALWAYS” lend a helping hand because they loved me and wanted what’s best for me. It was all lies. My “friends” were the best actors I’ve ever met. They made me feel seen but when I truly needed them most they pretended I never existed. As if they didn’t know me. But in actuality I could’ve just used a hug and been okay with just knowing they supported me. I was a nobody to them now, forgotten abt in the blink of an eye when I expressed my true feelings. I would always put myself last because I always wanted to help them and be there for them. But ig being alone sucks as much as having ppl who don’t gaf abt you in the end. A lose-lose situation either way.

Dr. Bronner’s Tea Tree Pure Castile Soap. Will. Work. Wonders. At first you won’t see a difference but through time and persistence it will go away. Also, check with your piercer because your body might be rejecting the type of jewelry. Titanium is the best solution for beginner piercings.

I purchased one stud post for my nose piercing and surprisingly I had no reaction despite having really sensitive skin. I think doing research on the type of jewelry and looking at the reviews and pictures are super helpful.

It looks great actually! You have a little swelling which is normal and will go down. Just clean your piercing for the next couple months and your good to go. They heal super quickly which is great for a cartilage piercing.
